howto: Tap an empty plot, then press Plant in the Field tab to sow a seed.
Water it for a head start; when the plot says READY, tap it to harvest.
Craft your harvest into products in the Craft tab, then sell them in Market or fill customer Orders.
Spend the profit on Upgrades, Staff and a bigger Venue, and switch between five businesses in the Theme tab.
tips: Hired staff keep harvesting, crafting and selling while the game is closed (at 80% speed, up to two hours).
Orders pay more than the Market: keep a few products in stock for the next customer.
Premium and legendary harvests are worth much more; the Quality upgrade makes them more likely.
Each venue level adds 10% to every sale and makes new plots cheaper to unlock.
Each business keeps its own cash, plots and staff, so a new theme is a fresh start.

controls.keyboard: Click plots and buttons. Keys 1-6 select a plot, W waters it, E harvests it, Q opens Craft, T opens Theme. Enter or Space starts from the title.
controls.touch: Tap a plot to select it (a READY plot is harvested), then use the Plant, Water and Harvest buttons and the tabs along the bottom dock.

difficulty: A relaxed idle game with no way to lose: each business starts with $25 and gets harder to grow as upgrades, staff wages and venues cost more, and missions set the next goal.

cheats.effect: Every planted crop is ready to harvest

features.offline-earnings: Hired staff work while you are away (80% rate, capped at two hours); a Welcome back card sums up what they did
features.upgrade-tree: Upgrades tab (yield, growth, quality and more, each with levels), Staff tab and five Venue levels
features.big-number-format: Money reads $950, $12.4K, $3.40M, $1.2B in the HUD, buttons and cards
features.prestige-or-next-goal: Missions tab lists the next goals with cash and XP rewards; ranks climb from Seedling up, and four more businesses unlock in the Theme tab
features.tutorial: A five-step guided first run (plant, water, harvest, craft, sell) with a Skip button; Replay tutorial in the arcade menu runs it again
features.results: End-of-day card: harvests, crafted, sold, takings, wages, cash and rank, with a Next day button
features.restart: Restart starts the current business again from day 1; the other businesses keep their progress
features.hints: The arcade Hint names the next useful move: a ready plot, something you can craft, an order you can fill
features.codes-on: Using a code marks the save CODES ON (a red tag under the header) for good
features.reduced-motion: Follows the browser's reduced-motion setting (no cash roll-ups, particles or customer walk-ins); Menu tab has its own switch
